_comment: Merge shepherds read review outcomes from the linked REVIEW comments and never author them; state authoring is denied at the mutation seam. Completion requires one disposition on the merge bead: LANDED on merge, BOUNCED when a fix bead goes back to the origin (bot findings, drift or conflict), ESCALATED when the review loop exhausted its limit, BLOCKED when the landing waits on a gate, provider or slot the comment names. Shepherds may write merge_sha/pr and close merge beads.
